hero.text: Hi! I'm Rooky, your chess coach. Welcome to Chackmate, chess for every age! Scroll down, and I'll show you around.

learn.text: This is me, teaching on a real board. Every time you move, I tell you why, in one simple sentence. No long words, I promise.

lessons.text: Start with how the pieces move, then try puzzles, famous openings and endgames. A new puzzle is waiting for you every day.

wonders.text: Every game happens somewhere amazing! Some places are grand rooms, and some are out in the open, right in front of a wonder of the world. Beat each champion to unlock the next place.

collect.text: Every chess set has its own story. Win them, collect them, and try them on your table! Nothing is random, and nobody can buy a stronger army.

item-sets-pharaoh.text: Look at this one shine! Pharaoh's Treasure is carved from smooth white alabaster and dark basalt, with collars of gold, blue lapis and red carnelian, just like a real pharaoh's jewels. Beat the champion in Ancient Egypt, and it's yours.

item-sets-olympian.text: Olympian Marble looks like it came straight from a temple in Athens. Bright white marble, bronze laurel leaves, and the Greek key pattern running all the way round. Every piece stands like a little statue of a hero.

item-sets-imperial.text: This set is fit for an emperor! Imperial Rome is white Carrara marble and deep purple porphyry, the stone only emperors could use, with golden laurels on top. Win in Rome, and you can rule the board with it.

item-sets-maharaja.text: Maharaja's Jade is one of my favourites. White and green jade, polished until it glows, and set with tiny rubies and emeralds, like the treasures of the Taj Mahal. It's a set made for a king.

item-sets-dynasty.text: Blue and white, like a precious Ming vase. Ming Porcelain is painted by hand in deep cobalt blue, and stands on red cinnabar lacquer carved with patterns. It feels like playing chess in the Forbidden City.
